newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot products notionally flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot products notionally flat.

text.p: U.S. Northwest products were little changed from Tuesday, traders said, with subdued California markets failing to give them a boost and prospects still weak for gasoline as motorist demand falls.
"The gasolines have been trending down and Number two (oil) has been hanging in," one trader said.
Seasonal declines in consumption occur in the cooler weather Pacific Northwest, where distribution racks have been lowering prices, according to industry sources.
Regular unleaded gasoline was assessed at 65 cents to 66 cents a gallon.

Jet fuel in Seattle was assessed one cent higher at 76/77 cents a gallon, while low sulphur diesel continued to see a correction from recent hyped up prices, falling half a cent to 74.50/75.50 cents a gallon.
